QuestInfo.name: Push the Line
QuestInfo.0: #p3001001# tells you that #p3001000# is looking for Kaiser. Go see #b#p3001000##k.
QuestInfo.1: To secure the supply route properly, you must clear a path all the way to the gathered #b#o2400109##k monsters. Eliminate #b#o2400109##k monsters and return.\n#rTo restart, please forfeit the quest first.#k
QuestInfo.2: While fighting #b#o2400109##k monsters, you encountered a Specter that seemed odd. You showed #p3001000# the emblem you obtained after killing that Specter and she said it's the #b#t4033361##k. Whatever the case, you succeeded in securing the supply route.

0.0: Your efforts in clearing the supply lines have opened up our options.\r\n#L0##bThose dogs were just being used. There's gotta be somebody controlling them. #l\n#k
0.1: Correct. And that is why I need you to take back the #b#m401010010##k. \r\n#L0##bI like how you tell me to do things.#l\n#k
0.2: It is one of my many talents. The battle will probably be frustrating, due to their high defense and shield usage, but I am sure you will overcome. Won't you?

yes.0: I know you will have no problems.

no.0: Hmm, maybe I can find the pink haired dancer to help us...

1.0: Looks like the shields gave you no trouble. Did you even get scratched?\r\n#L0##bOf course not. But there was this weird Specter there. It dropped this emblem thing...#l\n#k
1.1: Interesting. Specter generals carry these. What an unexpected gift you have turned out to be, Kaiser. \r\n#L0##bWhat? Did I get one of the big bad guys?#l\n#k
1.2: You just may have. Now take that emblem to #p3001001#.

item.0: The supply route is not safe enough yet.\n#rIf you wish to try again, you must forfeit and start over.#k

quest.0: There have been reports of continued Shieldbearer activities. You must help us stop them to open up our supply lines. \n#rIf you fail this quest, you must forfeit and start over.#k
